text: Answer to steenbarger: my higher-timeframe read is the swing class, W and D HH/HL, and that carries it for me. Setup is a TEST of a fresh break (C2/C20): D close_vs_swing_high_pct 0.09, the double stop point, my lowest-risk entry. Trigger h1_close_above:bar_high on H1; wrong if a daily close below bar_low. ma100 316.21 under ma200 316.75 is not on my menu, so I neither confirm nor refute it. My caution stands: 5.0% under the 20-day high is overhead supply, so this is a short test trade, measured in bars (C18). What would move me: W swing turning LH/LL.
